changeSet.author: codex
changeSet.comment: 固定 Sprint-93 模型目录同步与资产语义补齐动作的审计分类，避免运行时字符串推断产生错误口径
changeSet.sql:
INSERT INTO audit_module_catalog ( source_system, module_key, module_name, parent_module_key, owner, enabled, order_value, version, updated_at ) VALUES ( 'platform', 'modeling.dbt-roundtrip', 'dbt 可视化往返建模', 'modeling', 'platform', TRUE, 5000, 'sprint-93-audit-convergence-v1', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) ON CONFLICT (source_system, module_key) DO UPDATE SET module_name = EXCLUDED.module_name, parent_module_key = EXCLUDED.parent_module_key, owner = EXCLUDED.owner, enabled = EXCLUDED.enabled, version = EXCLUDED.version, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at;
WITH desired (action_code, operation_name, operation_kind) AS ( VALUES ('MODELING_SEMANTIC_SYNC_RETRY', '重试模型目录同步', 'REFRESH'), ('MODELING_SEMANTIC_SYNC_TERMINAL_FAILURE', '模型目录同步终态失败', 'REFRESH'), ('CATALOG_ASSET_SEMANTIC_BACKFILL_APPLY', '应用资产语义投影补齐批次', 'EXECUTE'), ('CATALOG_ASSET_SEMANTIC_BACKFILL_ROLLBACK', '回滚资产语义投影补齐批次', 'DELETE') ) INSERT INTO audit_action_catalog ( source_system, action_code, module_key, module_name, operation_code, operation_name, operation_kind, resource_type, allow_empty_targets, enabled, version, updated_at ) SELECT 'platform', desired.action_code, 'modeling.dbt-roundtrip', 'dbt 可视化往返建模', desired.action_code, desired.operation_name, desired.operation_kind, 'modeling.dbt-roundtrip', FALSE, TRUE, 'sprint-93-audit-convergence-v1', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM desired ON CONFLICT (source_system, action_code) DO UPDATE SET module_key = EXCLUDED.module_key, module_name = EXCLUDED.module_name, operation_code = EXCLUDED.operation_code, operation_name = EXCLUDED.operation_name, operation_kind = EXCLUDED.operation_kind, resource_type = EXCLUDED.resource_type, allow_empty_targets = EXCLUDED.allow_empty_targets, enabled = EXCLUDED.enabled, version = EXCLUDED.version, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at;
